shape: Dense T-junction (3 portals: S, W, E)
description: Three-portal T-shape with a wide shared interior. Unlike paru-A tb3's asymmetric two-anchor junction, this stage has each gate's entry hub directly connecting to multiple shared interior anchors — south_inner and west_inner each reach 5 shared anchors; east_inner is sparser (3 connections). The result is a richly-connected center where any portal can reach any interior anchor in 2–3 hops.

portals.south: spawn_south at (5.99, 26.66) — gate on the south (high-Z) side
portals.west: spawn_west at (-23.19, 7.62) — gate on the west (low-X) side
portals.east: spawn_east at (23.30, 5.87) — gate on the east (high-X) side

anchors.description: south entry hub — connects to 5 shared interior anchors (matches 6wijk3)
west entry hub — also connects to 5 (matches qauj6c)
east-mid transit / east arm's interior link (matches bxggx7)

traversalNotes: south ↔ west:  spawn_south → south_inner → north_center → west_inner → spawn_west (or via center / west_mid).
south ↔ east:  spawn_south → south_inner → east_inner → spawn_east (or south_inner → east_mid → east_inner).
west ↔ east:   spawn_west → west_inner → east_mid → east_inner → spawn_east.
DISPATCH RULE: south_inner and west_inner are the high-degree hubs and the canonical dispatch anchors. east_inner is sparser — east-side objectives generally route via east_mid as the staging hop.
Same primitive family as paru-A tb3 (3-portal T-junction) but with denser inner connectivity and 3 distinct inner-hubs instead of 2.
